column2: Angkor Git (AngKorGit) is a fast, free, open-source Git 客户端 and Git GUI for macOS, Windows, and Linux, built native with Tauri v2, Rust and libgit2. Visual commit graphs, side-by-side diff review, visual conflict resolution, and AI assistance.
column3: Angkor Git (AngKorGit) 是一款快速、免费、开源的 Git 客户端与 Git GUI，适用于 macOS、Windows 和 Linux，基于 Tauri v2、Rust 与 libgit2 原生构建。可视化提交图、并排 diff 审查、可视化冲突解决与 AI 辅助。
